items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

ctx.x: Bore you, okay. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

Because Louis Armstrong was probably the greatest exponent of being able to play one note and making it more meaning, with a great deal of energy. It’s getting that karma going on that note. Caruso could do it too. And maybe a few others but not many it seems.
Interesting. I want to take you back in your career a little bit. I’m trying to think now, you were born in 1935.
